response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg_mod FROM joined), grp AS (SELECT telescref, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS grp_avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS grp_avg_phase FROM joined GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.grp_avg_mod) AS avg_modulation_index, AVG(g.grp_avg_phase) AS avg_phase_shift, AVG(g.grp_avg_mod - o.overall_avg_mod) AS avg_diff_above_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.grp_avg_mod > o.overall_avg_mod GROUP BY g.weathprofile
